completionGate.statement: Not achieved until, on an operator-ratified sample: the economics report has run at baseline and at close; redundant executions per change for lanes with unchanged input digests are at most 1.2 across pre-push and merged preview with zero shadow disagreements; false-red round trips are zero for the three named gate classes; unjournaled submitter and lease deaths are zero; the median red-to-green episode is lower than the P0 baseline with the number stated; and the final PR is driven to Yeet merge-ready with the status flip and closeout reflection riding it.

stopConditions: Proof reuse would satisfy a lane for a package whose source the change touches, or would reuse across cache epochs or env profiles - fail loud and stop; the must-fail fixtures are the gate.
Enforcement is proposed before the shadow disagreement report is zero over a ratified sample.
Hosted-tier reuse of local proofs is proposed without a recorded parity-ledger decision.
A hygiene change weakens a security lane (gitleaks pinning, OSV, fork isolation) or a required hosted check to make local green easier.
Any new lock, lease, or scheduler is proposed; admission already exists and this packet changes what runs, not who may run.
